entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior visiting Ravnica who saved a Boros brigade and is offered command of a battalion by Aurelia.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The angelic guildmaster and warleader of the Boros Legion, who recruits Gideon to help retake the Ninth.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of warriors led by Aurelia, based at Sunhome.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose forces ambushed a Boros brigade and fight over the Ninth.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that, with the Rakdos, brawls over the Ninth.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that hides in the shadows and pulls puppet strings in the Ninth.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose turf once included the Ninth but who abandoned it to rebuild New Prahv.

entities.name: The Ninth
entities.description: A contested district of Ravnica at the edge of the One Hundred Steps, torn between guilds and home to unguilded Ravnicans.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros stronghold where its armies train and the war room stands.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed by guilds, where unguilded gateless are caught in guild warfare.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A world Gideon saw being devoured by extraplanar horrors.

entities.name: Rakdos, the demon lord
entities.description: The demon lord of the Rakdos guild, whose power Gideon considers less terrible than what he saw on Zendikar.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius seat that the guild had to rebuild after the Guildpact was broken.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: The pact binding Ravnica's guilds, which was broken.

events.summary: Gideon is escorted into the Boros war room and feels Aurelia's overwhelming angelic aura.
events.quote: her aura was an order of magnitude higher than any he had encountered

events.summary: Aurelia says she has heard Gideon saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.
events.quote: I have word that you saved an entire brigade of my Boros from a Rakdos ambush that would have killed every last one of them.

events.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
events.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

events.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
events.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

events.summary: Aurelia reveals the Boros were once led by a disgrace to the Legion, which forced a change in guild leadership.
events.quote: We were led by a disgrace to the Legion.

events.summary: Aurelia takes Gideon to a balcony overlooking Boros armies training and says she wishes to cleanse the Ninth.
events.quote: the Ninth is a stain on Ravnica, a stain on the Boros, and a stain on my soul.

events.summary: Aurelia offers Gideon command of a battalion, whether or not he joins the Boros.
events.quote: I am prepared to give you command of that battalion, there, if you will fight with us.

events.summary: Gideon recalls having seen Zendikar devoured and decides he is needed on Ravnica.
Gideon accepts, resolving to wield Boros weapons for the greater good without becoming Boros, and asks when they start.
events.quote: He was not ready to become Boros.

relations.note: She is the Boros guildmaster and warleader.
relations.quote: Gideon couldn't take his eyes off of the Boros guildmaster.

relations.note: Wishes to burn out the Rakdos in the Ninth.
relations.quote: I would love to go in there with some Cinder Elementals and burn out every last Rakdos, Gruul, and Dimir

relations.note: He agrees to lead her battalion against the guilds in the Ninth.
relations.quote: Gideon felt a sense of duty and allegiance to the angelic guildmaster rush up from deep within his chest.
the Ninth is a stain on Ravnica
